newsitem.title: USA: Clinton may visit Latin America in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Clinton may visit Latin America in 1997.

text.p: President Bill Clinton wants to travel to Latin America in the first half of 1997 and plans on Wednesday to discuss visiting Argentina with President Carlos Menem, the White House said.

"The president would like to make a trip to the region in the first half of 1997, but the sequence of stops and where he would go is yet to be determined," White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters.

"Argentina, given our close bilateral relations and the strength of the work that we do together on so many issues ... would be a likely stop," he said, adding Clinton would discuss a visit during a White House meeting on Wednesday morning with the Argentine president, who is making a private visit to the United States.
